en.title: Build a multi-model agent team with T3 Code
en.summary: Using Claude, Codex, and Gemini but still stuck as a middleman shuttling requirements and code between windows? The author uses T3 Code to turn multiple models into a development team, covering setup and configuration, task handoff, permission management, and cross-model review, with reusable team rules and role prompts.

en.title: 🔥 No modeling, no artists: one person used AI to build a full-fledged 3D action game that's genuinely playable—and released the full prompt set, from single-image rigging to a two-platform playable demo
en.summary: AI-generated 3D characters look cool—until they start moving, clipping through themselves, sliding around, or failing to grip a weapon. Using a Three Kingdoms action game, Fini breaks down the full pipeline from a single reference image to a title playable on both PC and mobile: standardizing character art, generating models and animations, compressing assets, then fixing animation details step by step while adding combat impact and boss fights.
